summary: Polibeli Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment to its Prepaid Share Forward Agreement, originally entered into on May 28, 2025, in connection with its August 7, 2025 business combination with Chenghe Acquisition II. The July 31, 2026 amendment extends the maturity date by 12 months. Under the agreement, Sellers (Harraden Circle entities) may purchase up to 3,000,000 ordinary shares from third parties plus 100,000 committed shares, with counterparty paying the redemption price from the trust account. Sellers may terminate portions, triggering payments based on the Reset Price. Watch for future amendments or open-market purchases affecting share overhang.
